The deprecated strike tag renders as strikethrough

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown-wasm";
function main() {
  const result = convert("<p><strike>gone</strike></p>");
  console.log(result.content);
}

void main();
```
